caption: The drawing features a simple basket at the bottom, composed of red and brown lines forming a grid pattern. From the basket emerge six curved green stems, each terminating in a red, tulip-shaped flower with green sepals. Along the stems are pairs of dark green, almond-shaped leaves. At the top center stem, a red bird with a dark green wing is perched, facing to the right, with a small green dot for its eye. The background is plain and off-white. At the bottom, the text reads: "FROM A WALL STENCIL GRAY MAINE 1800" in black, capitalized letters.
title: Design from Gray, Maine 1800 (no. 2): From Proposed Portfolio "Maine Wall Stencils"
